decisions.decision: Build now against the live v5 ids. Don't wait on T-022's lock. In workshop-plan/outputs/build.py, retag every section from the Q1 to Q38 tags to ids that exist in workshop-plan/build/questions.py: d1v5_* for Day 1, d2v5_channels to d2v5_commit for Day 2, d3v5_tools to d3v5_commit for Day 3. Where a section needs them, add the Day 0 ids mail_provider, stack_domains, stack_reminder_email, stack_crm, stack_ai, pay_checkout and send_senders. Delete any section that no question feeds. Use the survey gaps listed in docs/onboarding-v3/analysis/day2-day3.md (tags, qualification fields, platform choice, GA4 and others). Keep the templates as plain HTML with named data-slot attributes for T-031. Regenerate day1, day2 and day3.html. Extend probe-outputs.mjs so it imports the ids from questions.py and fails on any Q-number or unknown id. Run it, check grep -E '\bQ[0-9]+\b' build.py returns nothing, commit, publish to the mirror, then move to review with the links.
